text:
Ana: Quick sync — proposing a 72h micro-surge next Tue-Thu to aggressively shrink post-launch noise. Objective: close top customer-impact bugs, ship 1-2 <2d delight items, and trim backlog noise.

Devin: Sounds good. What's the guardrail on scope creep?

Mira: Strong guardrail: any item >2 dev-days gets punted to follow-on milestone unless it's a P0. We'll require repro steps and a minimal acceptance checklist before work starts.

Jamal: We have two infra-sensitive fixes that touch routing. Ops needs canary windows scheduled in advance. Can we lock the canary times now?

Kevin: Ops can support two 2hr canaries per day. Need change descriptions and rollback playbook attached to PRs. No runtime-touching changes without the rollback doc.

triage-bot: backlog-snapshot: total open issues 141, P0=1, P1=14, quick-delight candidates=5. link: https://redwood.internal/backlog/1777654321

Devin: Proposed shortlist: embed regression (customer-reported), prompt truncation edge case, remove legacy routing flag (quick-delight), close old low-signal bugs (housekeeping).

Mira: I'll prioritize by customer signal + telemetry spike. For embed regression we need repro corpus and customer context.

Ana: Acceptance checklist (must pass before merging): repro steps, unit+integration tests added, canary run 2h with no errors, smoke eval pass >=95% on core prompts.

Jamal: Ops note: if canary fails, we rollback and open a follow-up triage. Please also include config diff in the PR description.

Kevin: I'll add a template file for canary steps and a one-click rollback script snippet to the repo.

Devin: I'll own the quick-delight PRs and grooming. ETA: draft PRs by tomorrow 10am PT.

Mira: I'll publish the repro dataset and tag affected customers, plus a priority heatmap.

Ana: Decision: prioritize P0 and top two P1s by customer impact (embed regression + prompt truncation), ship legacy flag removal as quick-delight, and reserve a 1/2 day slot for bulk triage. No new features besides these.

triage-bot: created ticket micro-surge-1777654321 with checklist and invites.

Jamal: Ops will standby with hotline during the surge. Scheduling invites sent.

Ana: Final ask — if a fix is trending >2 dev days, flag it immediately and we'll move it to "micro-delight-2" unless it's P0. Keep PRs small.

Devin: Acknowledged, will keep changes scoped.

Mira: Will flag growth and escalate.

Ana: We'll run a 30m kickoff Tue 11:15am PT to lock scope and reviewers. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
